cohort: 299 women scheduled for caesarean delivery or admitted in labor at the Women's Hospital of the University of Campinas between August 2020 and August 2021.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic did not affect the PPIUD placement rate, which was 65.6%, and younger women, those without a partner, and those after vaginal delivery were more likely to accept a PPIUD.
mod_finding: Women after vaginal delivery were 1.7 times more likely to accept a PPIUD than those after caesarean delivery.
